header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the appellant nor any intimation is received. Even on
body: the last date of hearing Mr. Moinuddin Qureshi advocate hold brief on behalf of learned counsel for the appellant, which reflects that counsel for the appellant has lost interest in pursuing the matter. Therefore, this Court has no option but to dismiss the instant Criminal Acquittal Appeal for nonprosecution. Accordingly, it stands dismissed for non-prosecution. JUDGE *Chander Kumar*
